code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# Cross-species phenotype convergence for TANC2/Tanc2/tanc2 loss of function
# Rows = phenotype domain; columns = model system. 1 = reported, 0 = tested/not reported, nan = not assessed
rows = {
 "Hyperactivity / locomotor":      {"Human (IDDALDS)":1,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":1,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":np.nan,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":1,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":np.nan,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
 "Reduced anxiety-like behavior":  {"Human (IDDALDS)":0,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":1,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":np.nan,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":np.nan,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":1,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
 "Impaired social behavior":       {"Human (IDDALDS)":1,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":np.nan,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":1,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":np.nan,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":1,"Drosophila (40110879)":1},
 "Sensorimotor gating / stereotypy":{"Human (IDDALDS)":1,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":np.nan,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":np.nan,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":1,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":np.nan,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
 "Seizure / seizure susceptibility":{"Human (IDDALDS)":1,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":np.nan,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":np.nan,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":np.nan,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":np.nan,"Drosophila (40110879)":1},
 "Sleep disturbance":              {"Human (IDDALDS)":1,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":np.nan,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":np.nan,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":np.nan,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":1,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
 "Synaptic / spine abnormality":   {"Human (IDDALDS)":np.nan,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":np.nan,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":1,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":np.nan,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":1,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
 "Growth / skeletal abnormality":  {"Human (IDDALDS)":1,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":1,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":np.nan,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":1,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":1,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
 "Metabolic / hepatic abnormality":{"Human (IDDALDS)":0,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":1,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":np.nan,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":1,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":np.nan,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
 "Embryonic lethality (null)":     {"Human (IDDALDS)":np.nan,"Mouse IMPC (hom)":np.nan,"Mouse Tanc2+/- (33976205)":1,"Mouse DFM (34964047)":0,"Zebrafish KO (36534563)":0,"Drosophila (40110879)":np.nan},
}
M=pd.DataFrame(rows).T
print(M)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,6))
cmap=plt.cm.get_cmap("RdYlBu_r")
im=ax.imshow(M.values.astype(float),cmap="YlGnBu",vmin=0,vmax=1)
ax.set_xticks(range(M.shape[1])); ax.set_xticklabels(M.columns,rotation=35,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(M.shape[0])); ax.set_yticklabels(M.index,fontsize=9)
for i in range(M.shape[0]):
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        v=M.values[i,j]
        ax.text(j,i,"n.a." if np.isnan(v) else ("yes" if v==1 else "no"),ha="center",va="center",
                fontsize=8,color="white" if v==1 else "0.3")
ax.set_title("Cross-species recapitulation of TANC2 loss of function\n(yes = phenotype reported; no = assessed and absent; n.a. = not assessed)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
n_conv = int(((M==1).sum(axis=1)>=3).sum())
print("\nPhenotype domains reproduced in >=3 independent systems:", n_conv, "of", M.shape[0])
